recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a woman with voluminous 80s hair standing against a weathered brick wall. The composition features a surrealist 'peeled back' corner effect revealing a blue sky, combined with tall, condensed stencil-style typography and urban graffiti elements.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned right-of-center against a receding brick wall perspective
Tall, vertical typography balancing the horizontal brick lines
Contrast between gritty urban textures and a clean sky insert
Warm brick tones against cool blue denim and sky accents
coreInvariants: Red-brown brick wall with perspective receding to the left
Peeled-paper corner effect in the bottom right
80s fashion styling including a patterned blazer and high-waisted denim

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Woman occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, medium shot from waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and voluminous hair serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, moves left to the large vertical text, then down the brick wall to the peeled corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The left side of the frame is dominated by the brick wall and large-scale typography.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft pink and white (typography and highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, earthy tones in the background with high-value highlights on the subject's face and text.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high aspect ratio (tall and narrow)
Stencil-style horizontal gaps in the vertical strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Horizontal bars are thin and positioned at consistent heights across all letters

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over the brick wall texture

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between ultra-condensed vertical display text and ultra-wide horizontal subtitle text.
graphicDevices: White chalk-style graffiti on the brick wall
Circular badge in the bottom left

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed verticality and stencil cuts.
Appropriate for the wide, airy secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of a woman with 1980s feathered hair wearing a grey plaid blazer and blue jeans, standing against a red brick wall that recedes in perspective to the left. In the bottom right corner, the image appears to peel away like a sticker, revealing a bright blue sky with white clouds underneath. The brick wall has faint white chalk graffiti.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, ultra-condensed stencil-style uppercase text in the top left corner, stacked vertically. Add a secondary line of text in a wide, thin sans-serif font in the top right corner with very wide letter spacing. Place a small black circular badge with white sans-serif text in the bottom left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the main text ultra-condensed and stenciled?
Does the bottom right corner have a 'peeled' effect?
Is the hair styled in a voluminous 80s fashion?
Is the brick wall perspective correct?

adjustableVariables: Size of the peeled corner effect
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist

mustAchieve: Authentic 80s film grain and color grading
Clean execution of the trompe l'oeil peeled corner

postGenerationChecks: Check that the stencil gaps in the text are consistent.
Ensure the sky revealed in the corner looks like a separate layer.
Verify the plaid pattern on the blazer is consistent with 80s tailoring.
Confirm the vertical text does not overlap the subject's face.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban 80s aesthetic + condensed stencil typography + surrealist peeled-layer composition.
